verdict.rationale: CrewAI ships an official terminal CLI that creates projects from crew, flow, and template scaffolds and can run and test them. `crewai test` runs a crew for a set number of iterations and reports performance metrics. The docs also provide a setup prompt for coding agents that checks the CLI, which fits an agent-driven build-and-verify loop. Missing for 10: explicit docs on non-interactive/headless behavior (exit codes, machine-readable output), a documented catalog of runnable example agents, and hands-on corroboration of agents using the CLI to verify their builds.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can run the framework's example agents headlessly from a terminal so an agent can verify what it just built

citations.quote: The CrewAI CLI provides a set of commands to interact with CrewAI, allowing you to create, train, run, and manage crews & flows.
Create a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project.
This command will run your crew for a specified number of iterations and provide detailed performance metrics.
It installs the official CrewAI skills, checks the CLI, and points the agent at the right docs before it edits code.
